title: Parents vs passion: how to have the talk
caption:
'Doctor banna hai.' 'But I want to do design.' Sound familiar?

Most parents aren't against your dream; they're scared for your future. The trick is answering the fear, not the sentence. Here's how to plan the conversation: the right moment, the right facts and a middle path if you need one. Your type changes your pitch too.

Parents, read it from your side as well.

Have you had this talk yet? How did it go?
